description.value: TownePlace Suites by Marriott New York Manhattan/Chelsea is an extended-stay hotel at 140 West 28th Street, New York, NY, USA, 10001. It sits between Chelsea and Midtown South near Penn Station. Suites with kitchens suit a longer stay or a family trip. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The breakfast offers a good variety”; “Nicely updated room”. Representative watch-outs: “there are only four elevators, which often leads to long waits”.
